# SOP-04: Invoicing the day's orders

## Purpose

This procedure is how item 4 of the new process is done. [map/future.md item 4]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| bookkeeper | checks the day's invoices |
| operations manager | settles an invoice that does not match |

## When

Every working day; the invoice push runs at 18:00. [docs/run-log.md]

## Steps

1. The day's confirmed orders become invoices in QuickBooks Online with nothing retyped. [map/future.md item 4]
2. The bookkeeper checks the day's invoices (software step: see the Bookkeeper guide, "Check the invoices the day's orders produced"). [SC-12]

## Exceptions and who handles them

An order from an unknown customer makes no invoice; add the customer first. [SC-07]

## Escalation

The operations manager. [map/roles.md bookkeeper]

## Records kept

The run log keeps 90 days of runs, as the operations manager asked. [user-stated 2027-01-28]

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2027-02-03]
